g.text: Session drive events, per-device I/O and direct thermal evidence. Inventory is polled every 10
seconds; events between polls may be missed.
Latency is interval I/O time divided by completed operations; idle intervals have no latency.
Windows uses native 100ns time counters; Linux uses OS millisecond counters. Queue depth is
instantaneous. Devices and partitions can overlap; do not sum them. Busy time is not a universal
